Title: Public Preview: IQ Retriever Zero in Foundry IQ

Body.Content:
Foundry IQ can use an iterative retrieval model to break complex questions into focused searches. The model reviews search results and searches again when needed, within a configured budget, then passes the retrieved evidence to the model that answers the question.

Learn more.
